name: pf-fix-firearms-cannon-pistol-right
about: fix-firearms-cannon-pistol-right against the built package firearms instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). A Hand Cannon in the main hand with a pistol in the off hand, and the other way round (2026-10-22, the user's item 3): the right click fires both guns (attacks_firearms.sval glock_off bothc / hcannon_off with the main gun's marker). Through the fix_firearms_feel bot: `hwp firearms hands` shows both markers and the off-hand gun skill, a right click spends 2 rounds, a held right click keeps firing, one round left fires alone, and no gun cycle fires nothing (Combat.as HWPFirearmsGun.Deactivate logs 'cycle fired no round' with the hands when it does).

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] hands: main hwp_hcannon_mh_01, off hwp_glock_oh_01, markers glock_off hcannon_main, clip \d+/\d+, off skill hwp_attack_glock_off cycle \d+ ms
